lines.text: The scoffers who rule in Jerusalem say they have made a covenant with death and an agreement with Sheol.
The Lord GOD says He lays a precious cornerstone in Bethel, and the one who believes will never be shaken.
Hail will sweep away their refuge of lies, and their covenant with death will be dissolved.
The LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim and rouse Himself as in the Valley of Jezreel.
Caraway is beaten out with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
